title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

suppliers.sup:70510: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Part 350011 – price adjustment from 01/2027: our proposal
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer for the IE3 7.5 kW motor (part:350011). We value our long partnership and want to keep this supply stable.

Our demand is growing: forecast fc:350011@2026-09 records a change of 11.9 % for this part. Our commitment is 6110 pcs per year over 12 months from 01 January 2027.

The attached term sheets offer alternatives, including longer payment terms, which ease your working capital. As the requested change exceeds 2 %, could your pricing committee review them at its next meeting?

Could you also tell us the earliest lead time you can confirm, and whether a cheaper variant of the motor is available?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Part 350011 – price adjustment from 01/2027: our proposal
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our pricing committee has reviewed your updated volume forecast, which we have now factored into our revised calculation. We can accept your terms and await your order.

Our updated Angebot stands at a price of €361.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our technical and logistics departments will address your inquiries regarding lead times and alternative motor variants separately. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Application Engineering: Please note that we build strictly according to your provided drawing, and we do not propose any design changes.

Logistics: As part of our standard procedures, please be advised that our Lieferzeit is 35 days.
